topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's learning outcomes and outlines the core themes of cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers of tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors initiate and evolve through Darwinian selection of genetic mutations alongside epigenetic changes in transcriptional state.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and examine experimental evidence identifying the cell of origin in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promoters, inflammation, and stromal support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how non-mutagenic promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal cells drive malignant transformation and tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Technologies for studying tumor evolution and microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: It examines the sequencing, spatial omics, and computational methods used to analyze clonal evolution and cellular interactions in tumor tissue.

topics.label: Integrated model of cancer co-evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes the required interplay of mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and permissive microenvironmental conditions in cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
